# Layer-reorder contract provenance

`layer-reorder-contract.json` is an original Chromarchy keyboard and resource
contract. The paired shortcuts deliberately express inverse flat-layer moves.
The 300,000-square sparse case and odd 1,025 repetition count ensure repeated
down/up operations return to the same order without copying or allocating
pixel tiles.

The fixture does not define nested groups, multi-layer selection, pointer drag
behavior, or a persisted shortcut schema. Those remain separate capabilities.
